mainEntity.name: What types of addiction does Bonvie Recovery treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonvie Recovery treats a wide range of substance use disorders, including addiction to alcohol, prescription medications, and illicit drugs. Their programs are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, with a focus on long-term recovery and relapse prevention.

mainEntity.name: What therapies are used at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bonvie Recovery uses evidence-based therapies such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step facilitation. These are combined with holistic practices like yoga, meditation, Reiki, and art therapy to promote healing of the mind, body, and spirit.

mainEntity.name: How long are the treatment programs at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clients can choose from flexible program lengths of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days. Each program includes medical detox (if required), daily therapy sessions, holistic activities, and comprehensive aftercare planning.

mainEntity.name: Is family involved in the treatment process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Bonvie Recovery strongly encourages family involvement. The center provides support around topics like codependency, boundary setting, and healthy communication to help families heal alongside their loved ones.

mainEntity.name: What happens after I complete my program at Bonvie Recovery?

acceptedAnswer.text: After completing the residential program, clients receive personalized aftercare planning, access to virtual outpatient support, and participation in alumni groups. These services help maintain sobriety and support ongoing personal growth.

about_blocks.text: Bonvie Recovery, located near Kingston, Ontario, offers a comprehensive, individualized approach to addiction and mental health treatment. Rooted in their “Leading with Love” philosophy, Bonvie creates personalized care plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. Their evidence-based therapies include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), and 12-Step programming, delivered through both individual and group sessions. To support holistic healing, clients also benefit from practices such as yoga, meditation, Reiki, sound therapy, and art and music therapy—addressing the physical, emotional, and spiritual dimensions of recovery. Bonvie emphasizes family involvement, offering education and support around codependency, boundaries, and relationship rebuilding. Flexible residential program durations of 30, 45, 60, or 90 days are available, all set in a peaceful, lakeside environment ideal for healing. Medical detox, daily therapy, and wellness activities are part of each program. To promote long-term recovery, Bonvie also offers aftercare planning, virtual outpatient services, and alumni support groups. This well-rounded approach ensures clients are supported every step of the way—during and after their stay—making Bonvie Recovery a trusted destination for transformative care in Ontario.
